从一个目标开始，逐步把想法变成影片。: Start with a goal, then turn your idea into a film.
在项目空间点击「新建项目」，输入名称。默认画幅为 1080 × 1920 竖屏，: In Projects, choose New project and enter a name. The default format is 1080 × 1920 portrait; you can adjust it inside the project.
打开项目内的「素材」，导入图片、视频、音频、文字资料或 PDF。公共素材适合存放: Open Media in the project to import images, videos, audio, text documents or PDFs. Use Shared media for references you reuse across projects.
从「脚本」开始构思，到「制作画布」设计镜头和生成素材，最后在「成片」中剪辑。已有: Develop the story in Script, design shots and generate media in Production canvas, then edit in Film. Existing media can also go straight onto the timeline.
只使用已有素材进行手动剪辑和本地导出，无需配置 AI 模型。: Manual editing and local export with existing media do not require an AI model.
对话模型负责理解和操作，媒体模型负责生成素材。: Chat models interpret requests and operate tools; media models generate assets.
在首页「模型 → 服务连接」中添加服务，按服务要求填写地址和 API Key，再: Open Models → Service connections from the home page. Add the service URL and API key as required, then add a chat model and make it the default.
分别配置图像、视频或音频模型。参考图片、视频、首尾帧等输入是否可用，取决于所选模: Configure image, video or audio models as needed. Support for image or video references and start/end frames depends on the selected model.
在「Agents」中启用需要的角色，编辑职责、装配 Skills 并设置工具权限: In Agents, enable the roles you need, edit their instructions, attach Skills and set tool permissions. Start with the project coordinator or choose a specialist for a specific task.
在线模型使用你自己的服务账号，费用由服务商收取；调用时提示词和所选参考会发送给对: Online models use your own service account and are billed by the provider. Prompts and selected references are sent to that service when you use it.
说清目标、引用对象和修改范围，更容易得到可检查的结果。: Specify the goal, reference the object and define the scope so results are easy to review.
在对话中输入 @，选择脚本、镜头、素材或时间线片段；也可使用对象菜单中的「引用到: Type @ in the conversation to select a script, shot, asset or timeline clip, or use its Reference in chat menu action. Type $ to choose a specialist Agent.
例如：「用这些参考写一支 15 秒短片，保存脚本，先不要生成素材。」局部修改时，: For example: “Use these references to write and save a 15-second script. Do not generate media yet.” For a local edit, specify: “Change only shot 2 and keep the existing dialogue.”
Skill 提供工作方法，工具权限决定 Agent 能执行什么；完成一次操作后，: Skills provide methods; tool permissions determine what an Agent can execute. Review the content and visuals after each operation.
先确认故事，再细化每个镜头的画面和节奏。: Confirm the story before refining each shot and its rhythm.
进入「脚本」，让编剧 Agent 起草或手动编写。分别检查画面与动作、台词与旁白: Open Script to draft with the creative direction Agent or write manually. Review action, dialogue and narration, on-screen text, sound and planned duration.
确认脚本后选择「设计整片镜头」，在制作画布检查分镜导演 Agent 设计的构图、: After reviewing the script, choose Plan the whole film’s shots. In Production canvas, inspect the composition, action, camera position, movement and cut points that the creative direction Agent designed.
引用具体段落或镜头继续修改。脚本改动后，检查关联镜头是否需要同步，再制作分镜图；: Reference a paragraph or shot for further edits. After script changes, review linked shots before producing storyboard images. Multiple keyframes can describe complex actions.
脚本预计时长用于规划，成片实际时长由时间线上的素材和剪辑决定。: Script duration is a plan. Final duration comes from the media and edits on the timeline.
围绕镜头准备描述和参考，先预览，再选用。: Prepare prompts and references for each shot, then preview before using the result.
在制作画布中选择镜头或生成入口，选择媒体模型，填写描述、添加参考，并检查模型支持: Select a shot or generation action in Production canvas. Choose a media model, write a prompt, add references and check supported settings such as format and duration.
检查输入后开始生成，在任务详情查看进度和返回结果。生成图片与生成视频是独立任务，: Review the inputs and start generation. Follow progress and results in the task details. Image and video generation are separate tasks; create each as needed.
双击或预览生成结果，检查主体、动作和一致性。满意后使用「加入时间线」；需要修改时: Double-click or preview the result to check the subject, action and consistency. Choose Add to timeline when satisfied. To revise, reference the result and explain what to keep and change.
提交状态不明确时，先查询原任务或到服务商核查，避免重复提交产生额外费用。: If submission status is unclear, check the original task or provider before submitting again to avoid extra charges.
用时间线确定最终顺序、切点、声音和时长。: Use the timeline to set the final order, cuts, sound and duration.
在「成片」中移动、分割、裁剪和变速。双击片段打开属性，调整画面大小、位置、不透明: In Film, move, split, trim and retime clips. Double-click a clip to adjust scale, position, opacity or volume. Right-click for object actions.
可分离视频音频并调整淡入淡出，手动添加字幕或导入 SRT，也可用本机声音生成配音: Detach video audio and adjust fades, add captions manually or import SRT, and generate speech with installed system voices. Add transitions between adjacent base-track visuals and adjust clip colors as needed.
裁剪保留片段速度；剪切和删除会留下空隙，不会自动移动其他片段。: Trimming preserves clip speed. Cutting and deleting leave gaps and do not automatically move other clips.
项目会自动保存，重要作品仍建议单独备份。: Projects save automatically; keep separate backups of important work.
停止操作约 1.5 秒后，项目自动保存到本机。离开前检查工作栏中的保存状态；自动: The project saves locally about 1.5 seconds after editing stops. Check the save status in the toolbar before leaving. Autosave is not a version-history backup.
在「通用设置 → 存储」查看素材位置，也可选择新目录并迁移。素材缺失时，先检查磁: In General → Storage, inspect the media location or choose a new folder and migrate. If media is missing, check the drive and original file location; restoring files there recovers references.
语言可在「通用设置 → 语言」切换；界面语言不会翻译已有项目名称、脚本或聊天内容: Change the interface language in General → Language. This does not translate existing project names, scripts or conversations.
先确认配置和任务状态，再继续操作。: Check configuration and task status before continuing.
助手无法使用参考: The assistant cannot read a reference
检查对话模型是否支持对应的图片、视频、音频或 PDF 输入，确认引用的是当前任务: Check whether the chat model supports the reference’s image, video, audio or PDF input. Verify the reference is relevant to the task and follow the error message.
生成失败或结果未收取: Generation failed or results are missing
展开任务详情查看原因，检查服务连接和模型参数。已有任务优先查询状态或重试收取结果: Open task details to inspect the error, service connection and model settings. For an existing task, query status or retry receiving results before deciding to generate again.
浏览器中无法导入或导出: Import or export is unavailable in the browser
浏览器页面用于界面预览；素材导入、原生播放、生成任务和导出等完整流程请使用桌面应: The browser page is a UI preview. Use the desktop app for the full workflow, including importing media, native playback, generation tasks and export.
反馈问题时附上系统版本、复现步骤和脱敏后的错误信息，勿包含 API Key 或私: When reporting a problem, include your OS version, reproduction steps and sanitized error details. Exclude API keys and private media.
从想法到成片，一步步完成你的创作。: From idea to finished film, one step at a time.
在时间线选中片段后使用快捷键；输入文字时保留文字编辑快捷键。: Select a timeline clip before using shortcuts. Text fields keep their text-editing shortcuts.
在桌面应用中管理存储: Manage storage in the desktop app
当前为浏览器预览，无法读取本机素材目录。请在 Mstudio 桌面应用中查看位置: This browser preview cannot read your local media folder. Open the Mstudio desktop app to view its location or migrate files.
素材保存在此目录。更换位置时，会复制并校验已有文件，完成后重新载入应用。: Media is stored in this folder. Changing its location copies and verifies existing files, then reloads the app.
无法读取存储位置: Unable to read the storage location
请重试读取。若仍失败，可展开详情查看原因。: Try reading it again. If it still fails, expand the details to inspect the cause.
仅更改界面语言，不会翻译项目内容和聊天记录。: Changes only the interface language, without translating project content or conversations.
浏览器预览项目保存在当前浏览器中，与桌面项目相互独立。清除浏览器数据会移除这些预: Preview projects are saved in this browser, separately from desktop projects. Clearing browser data removes these preview projects.
自动保存不等于历史备份，重要项目请另行备份应用数据和素材。: Autosave is not a versioned backup. Back up application data and media separately for important projects.
立即应用于整个工作区并自动记住选择，不改变素材颜色和导出画面。: Applies across the workspace and remembers your choice. Media colors and exported frames stay unchanged.
去除暖色倾向，使用中性灰白背景: Neutral gray and white surfaces without a warm tint
加深辅助文字和分隔线，让控件边界更清楚。: Darken secondary text and dividers for clearer control boundaries.
本次外观已生效，但未能保存偏好，下次打开可能恢复默认。: Appearance applied, but the preference could not be saved. It may reset next time.
正在连接官方发布源…: Connecting to the official release source…
未能完成更新检查，请检查网络后重试，或直接查看发布页面。: Could not check for updates. Check your connection and retry, or visit the release page.
发现新版本 {version}，可前往发布页面查看说明和可用安装包。: Version {version} is available. Visit the release page for notes and available installers.
当前版本不低于最新正式发布版本 {version}。: Your version is at least as recent as the latest stable release, {version}.
未找到可公开读取的正式发布，暂时无法确认是否有更新。: No publicly accessible stable release was found. Update availability cannot be confirmed yet.
手动检查 GitHub 正式发布；不会自动下载或安装。: Manually checks stable GitHub releases. Does not download or install automatically.
浏览器预览仅比较此预览的版本，不能检测本机已安装的桌面版本。: The browser preview compares its own version and cannot detect the desktop version installed on your computer.
无法打开浏览器，请手动访问：: Could not open the browser. Visit this address manually:
请在桌面应用中管理素材目录: Manage media storage in the desktop app
暂无可查询的正式版本: No stable release available to check
查看对话里的工具操作结果，再到脚本、画布或时间线检查。: Read tool results in the conversation, then inspect the script, canvas or timeline.
退出应用后备份应用数据目录；如果迁移过素材目录，也要备份设置中显示的素材文件夹。: Quit the app before backing up its data directory. If you migrated media, also back up the media folder shown in settings.
播放完整影片，检查画面、声音、字幕和结尾。点击「导出成片 → 开始导出」，完成后: Play the entire film and check visuals, sound, captions and the ending. Choose Export film → Start export. Preview the completed result, then choose Save MP4…. After saving, show the file in its folder or choose Done to return to editing.
准备一段视频或几张图片，先走通导入、剪辑和导出。无需配置 AI。: Start with a video or a few images. Import, edit and export them without setting up AI.
新建项目，选择画幅: Create a project and choose its format
在「项目空间」点击「新建项目」，填写名称并选择「项目画幅」。手机竖屏视频选 9:: In Projects, choose New project, enter a name and select Project format. Use 9:16 for portrait, 16:9 for landscape or 1:1 for square video, then choose Create project.
点击工作栏的「素材」，在「项目素材」中点击「导入」，选择本机的图片或视频。导入后: Open Media in the toolbar. In Project media, choose Import and select a local image or video. Double-click its thumbnail to check the preview.
加入时间线并播放: Add it to the timeline and play
右键点击素材，选择「加入时间线」，再切换到「成片」。按空格播放或暂停；拖动片段调: Right-click the asset and choose Add to timeline, then switch to Film. Press Space to play or pause. Drag clips to arrange them, or drag their edges to trim them.
点击「导出成片 → 开始导出」。完成后预览，再点击「保存 MP4…」选择保存位置: Choose Export film → Start export. Preview the result, then choose Save MP4… and select a destination. When Video saved appears, you can open the containing folder.
能在所选文件夹找到并播放 MP4，就完成了第一次创作。项目会另行自动保存，方便继: Your first video is ready when the MP4 is in your chosen folder and plays correctly. The project autosaves separately so you can keep editing.
导入素材不会自动加入成片。只有放进时间线的内容，才参与最终编排。: Importing media does not add it to the film. The timeline determines what appears in the edit.
顶部切换创作阶段；「素材」和「Agent」可以随时打开。: Switch stages at the top. Open Media or Agent whenever you need them.
写画面与动作、台词、画面文字和声音。这里的时长是计划，不会直接改变时间线。: Write the action, dialogue, on-screen text and sound. Durations here are a plan; they do not directly change the timeline.
整理参考、设计镜头、生成图片和视频。镜头是拍摄方案，分镜图是用来检查构图和动作的: Organize references, design shots and generate images or video. A shot describes the planned action; a storyboard image is a still used to check composition and movement. Creating that image does not also create a video.
在时间线上安排画面、声音和字幕。同一素材可以多次使用，每次使用都是一个可单独裁剪: Arrange visuals, audio and captions on the timeline. Each use of an asset creates a clip you can trim and adjust independently. The playhead marks the current preview or edit position.
素材与 Agent：准备材料，协助操作: Media and Agent: gather assets and get help
「素材」存放导入和生成的文件；「公共素材」适合跨项目复用。「Agent」是创作助: Media holds imported and generated files; Shared media is for reuse across projects. An Agent can write scripts, prepare media or edit clips. Selecting an object does not automatically reference it in chat.
不必从头走完所有阶段。已有视频可以直接剪辑；只想写脚本，也可以停在脚本。: Use only the stages you need. Edit existing video directly, or stop after writing a script.
使用助手需要对话模型；生成图片或视频，还需要对应的媒体模型。: The assistant needs a chat model. Generating images or videos also needs a model for that media type.
回到项目空间，打开「模型 → 服务连接 → 添加连接」。按所选服务填写地址与 A: From Projects, open Models → Service connections → Add connection. Enter the URL and API key, or complete account sign-in as required by your service, then save. An API key is the credential supplied by your provider.
配置并测试对话模型: Set up and test a chat model
进入「对话」，点击「添加模型」，选择服务和型号。保存后点击「测试连接」，再选择「: In Chat, choose Add model and select a service and model. Save, choose Test connection, then set the Default chat model. To use image or video references, select a model that supports those inputs.
需要生成时，再添加媒体模型: Add media models when you need them
在「图像」或「视频」中配置要使用的型号。对话模型连通，不代表已经能生成图片或视频: Configure the models you need in Images or Video. A working chat connection does not enable image or video generation by itself. Check the generation form for supported reference types, formats and durations.
回到项目打开「Agent」，发送一句简单请求并收到回复，再继续写脚本或制作素材。: Return to a project, open Agent and confirm that a simple request receives a reply before starting your script or media work.
在线模型的可用额度和费用取决于你的服务账号。调用时，提示词和所选参考会发送给对应: Availability and charges depend on your service account. Prompts and selected references are sent to that service when you use an online model.
让助手准确执行任务: Give the assistant a clear task
说清要改什么、改到什么程度，以及哪些内容要保留。: Specify what to change, the intended result and what to preserve.
引用对象，再描述要求: Reference the object, then describe the change
打开「Agent」，输入 @ 并从列表选择脚本、镜头、素材或时间线片段，也可右键: Open Agent, type @ and select a script, shot, asset or timeline clip, or right-click the object and choose Reference in chat. Check the reference name before sending. To change a specific use of media, reference its timeline clip.
按任务选择助手: Choose an assistant for the task
不确定选谁时，交给「项目统筹」。也可以输入 $，从已启用的角色中选择编剧、分镜导: Start with the project coordinator if you are unsure. Or type $ to choose an enabled role for writing, shot planning, image production, video production or editing.
到工作区检查结果: Check the result in the workspace
展开对话里的操作结果，再到脚本、画布或时间线核对。助手给出建议、保存内容和完成生: Expand the operation results in chat, then check the script, canvas or timeline. Advice, saved changes and generated media are different outcomes. If you only received advice, ask the assistant to save it in the intended location.
用我引用的素材写一支 15 秒咖啡店短片，给附近上班的人看。保存到脚本，先不要生: Use the referenced media to write a 15-second coffee shop video for nearby office workers. Save it to Script. Do not generate images or videos yet.
在对应工作区看到实际修改，并确认没有改动要求保留的内容。: Confirm the actual changes in the relevant workspace and check that the content you wanted to preserve remains intact.
进阶配置在首页「Agents」与「Skills 能力库」。Agent 是执行任务: Advanced configuration is in Agents and the Skills library on the home page. Agents perform tasks, Skills provide methods, and tool permissions determine which actions they can take.
先把内容说清楚，再决定每个镜头的画面和动作。: Get the story right before planning the visuals and action for each shot.
进入「脚本」，点击「和 Agent 开始创作」，说明主题、观众和大致时长，检查后: In Script, choose Start with Agent, describe the subject, audience and approximate duration, then review and send. Choose Write manually to draft it yourself. Import references first, then attach them with @.
逐段检查画面与动作、台词与旁白、画面文字、声音和预计时长。例如，想让观众看到杯口: Review each section’s action, dialogue, on-screen text, sound and planned duration. If the viewer should see steam rising from a cup, put it in the visual description, not just the narration.
在「设计整片镜头」区域点击「根据完整脚本设计镜头」；已有镜头时按钮为「调整整片镜: In the shot-planning section, choose Plan shots from the full script; if shots exist, choose Adjust all shots. Review and send the prepared task in the assistant, then inspect the shots in Production canvas.
脚本改动后，检查关联镜头、分镜图和视频是否仍然适用。不要把更新脚本理解为已经重新: After changing the script, check whether the linked shots, storyboard images and videos still fit. Updating a script does not mean media has been regenerated or the edit synchronized.
脚本说清完整内容；每个镜头都能看懂主体、动作和拍法，再开始制作画面。: Before producing media, check that the script tells the full story and each shot clearly describes its subject, action and camera treatment.
先做一个镜头，检查结果后再继续制作其他镜头。: Make one shot first. Review its result before producing the others.
在「制作画布」选择要处理的镜头或素材，通过生成入口或助手开始制作。说明主体外观、: Select the shot or asset in Production canvas and start from a generation action or the assistant. Describe the subject, action, setting and details to preserve, and add relevant references.
检查图像或视频模型、参考用途、画幅与时长。首帧是视频开始时的画面，尾帧是结束时的: Check the image or video model, reference roles, format and duration. A start frame defines the opening image and an end frame defines the closing image; support depends on the model. Submit image and video jobs separately.
查看任务，检查结果: Track the job and review the result
在工作栏打开任务列表，查看进度或展开失败原因。结果返回后预览，重点检查主体是否正: Open the task list in the toolbar to track progress or inspect an error. Preview the returned result and check the subject, movement and consistency with adjacent shots.
选用或继续修改: Use the result or revise it
满意后选择「加入时间线」，到「成片」检查。需要修改时，引用具体结果，说明保留哪些: Choose Add to timeline when satisfied, then check Film. To revise a result, reference it and specify what to preserve and change. A result on the canvas is not necessarily part of the final edit.
保留这张图的杯子外观、机位和背景，只让杯口的热气更明显，不增加文字。: Keep the cup, camera angle and background in this image. Make only the steam above the cup more visible. Do not add text.
任务状态不明确时，先查询原任务或重试收取结果；必要时到服务商核查，再决定是否重新: If a job’s status is unclear, check the original job or retry collecting its result. Check with the provider if necessary before generating again.
在「成片」完成最终顺序、时长、声音和字幕。: Set the final sequence, timing, sound and captions in Film.
拖动片段调整位置，拖动边缘裁剪。需要分割时，选中片段，点击时间尺定位播放头，再按: Drag clips to move them or drag their edges to trim. To split, select a clip, position the playhead on the ruler and press ⌘B (Windows: Ctrl+B). Deleting or cutting leaves a gap; move later clips yourself if needed.
双击时间线片段打开属性，调整大小、位置、不透明度、速度或音量。需要单独处理视频声: Double-click a timeline clip to open its properties. Adjust scale, position, opacity, speed or volume. Detach a video’s audio to work on its sound separately and adjust fades.
打开「创作 → 字幕 / 配音」，手动添加字幕或导入 SRT 字幕文件，也可用本: Open Create → Captions / Voiceover. Add captions manually, import an SRT caption file, or generate speech using installed system voices. Listen back and check when each caption appears and disappears.
从头检查，再导出: Review the whole film, then export
从头播放到结尾，检查黑屏空隙、声音音量、字幕和最后一帧。点击「导出成片 → 开始: Play from beginning to end. Check gaps, sound levels, captions and the final frame. Choose Export film → Start export, preview the result, then choose Save MP4…. You still need to select a file destination after rendering finishes.
保存后的 MP4 能正常播放，画面、声音和字幕与预期一致。: The saved MP4 plays correctly, with the intended visuals, audio and captions.
转场用于符合条件的相邻底层画面片段；想先完成第一版，可以只做直接切换，之后再调整: Transitions apply to eligible adjacent clips on the base visual track. Finish a first cut with straight cuts, then refine transitions and color.
自动保存保留可编辑的项目；导出的 MP4 用于播放和分享。: Autosave keeps the editable project. An exported MP4 is for playback and sharing.
离开前确认保存状态: Check the save status before leaving
停止操作约 1.5 秒后，项目自动保存到本机。将鼠标移到工作栏项目名旁的状态图标: The project saves locally about 1.5 seconds after you stop editing. Hover over the status icon next to its name in the toolbar to check. If Save failed appears, inspect the error and choose Retry save.
打开「通用设置 → 存储」查看素材目录。需要换位置时使用「选择新目录并迁移」，迁: Open General → Storage to find the media folder. To move it, choose Select a new folder and migrate, and keep the storage device connected throughout. Moving files directly can leave media missing from the project.
备份项目和素材: Back up the project and its media
重要项目请在退出应用后备份应用数据目录；如果迁移过素材，也要备份设置中显示的素材: For important projects, quit the app and back up its application data folder. If media was migrated, also back up the folder shown in settings. An MP4 alone cannot restore the original script, shots or edit structure.
自动保存会记录最新修改，不是历史版本备份。「通用设置 → 语言」只切换界面，不翻: Autosave records your latest changes; it is not a versioned backup. General → Language changes the interface, not your existing content.
按当前遇到的情况查找处理方法。: Find the issue that matches what you are seeing.
找不到生成的画面，或导出按钮不可用: Generated media is missing from the film, or export is unavailable
先在任务详情确认结果是否已返回，再检查素材或画布。要用于成片，请选择「加入时间线: Check the task details for a returned result, then look in Media or on the canvas. Choose Add to timeline to use it in the film. Export is unavailable when the timeline is empty; shots and references on the canvas are not added automatically.
助手连不上，或看不懂引用的资料: The assistant cannot connect or read a reference
到「模型 → 对话」测试连接，检查服务账号、地址和默认模型。连接正常但读不了附件: Test the connection in Models → Chat. Check the service account, URL and default model. If the connection works but attachments fail, check input support for images, video, audio or PDFs, and confirm you referenced the file with @ before sending.
生成失败、长时间没有结果: Generation failed or no result has arrived
展开任务详情查看错误和任务状态。先尝试查询原任务或重试收取已有结果；若提示参数不: Expand the task details to inspect its error and status. Try checking the original job or collecting its existing result first. For unsupported settings, adjust references, duration or format for that model. Confirm failure before deciding to submit again.
改了脚本，视频没有一起改变: The video did not change after editing the script
脚本、生成素材和时间线分别编辑。更新脚本后，先核对关联镜头，再决定是否重新制作素: Scripts, generated media and the timeline are edited separately. After changing the script, review linked shots, decide whether new media is needed, then update the clips on the timeline.
到「通用设置 → 存储」检查目录是否可用，重新连接原存储设备。若移动过文件，放回: Check that the folder in General → Storage is available and reconnect the original storage device. If files were moved, restore them to their original locations and check again. Locate existing files before regenerating them.
浏览器里不能导入、生成或导出: Import, generation or export does not work in the browser
浏览器页面用于界面预览。文件导入、原生播放、生成任务和导出等完整流程请在桌面应用: The browser page is an interface preview. Use the desktop app for the full import, native playback, generation and export workflow. Browser preview projects are separate from desktop projects.
仍未解决时，反馈系统版本、操作步骤和脱敏后的错误信息。请勿附上 API Key: If the issue persists, report your system version, steps to reproduce and redacted error details. Do not include API keys or private media.
换个关键词，或清除搜索查看全部章节。: Try another term, or clear the search to see all chapters.
从想法开始，用 AI 创作: Create with AI from an idea
连接模型 → 脚本 → 镜头与素材: Connect models → script → shots and media
先选中片段，再使用快捷键。点击时间尺定位播放头；输入文字时保留文字编辑快捷键。: Select a clip before using editing shortcuts. Click the ruler to position the playhead. Text fields retain their text-editing shortcuts.
在时间线上快速播放、裁剪和调整片段。: Play, trim and adjust clips on the timeline.
从一段视频或几张图片开始，试着剪出顺序，再保存成一支视频。暂时不用连接 AI。: Start with a video or a few images. Put them in order, then save your first video. You can try this without connecting AI.
放入你的图片或视频: Bring in your images or video
一份可以播放和分享的 MP4。可编辑的项目也会自动保存，随时可以回来接着做。: An MP4 you can play and share. Your editable project also saves automatically, ready for you to return to.
想让某份素材出现在视频里，记得把它加入时间线。其他素材可以先留着备用。: Add media to the timeline when you want it in the video. You can keep the rest for later.
写内容、准备画面、剪成视频，各有一个工作区。用顶部导航就能来回切换。: There is a workspace for writing, preparing visuals and editing. Switch between them using the navigation at the top.
想和 AI 一起创作，先连接一个对话模型。需要做图片或视频时，再添加对应的模型。: Connect a chat model to start working with AI. Add an image or video model when you need to generate media.
选一个对话模型，试试连接: Choose a chat model and try the connection
打开项目里的「Agent」，就可以开始对话了。可以先发一句「帮我想几个短片主题」: Open Agent in your project to start a conversation. Try asking, “Help me think of a few short-film ideas.”
把想法告诉助手，也可以带上参考，一边看结果，一边调整。: Share your idea and any references with the assistant, then refine it as you see the results.
告诉助手，你想改哪里: Show the assistant what you want to change
打开「Agent」，输入 @ 选择想讨论的脚本、镜头或素材，也可以右键选择「引用: Open Agent and type @ to choose a script, shot or asset to discuss. You can also right-click and choose Reference in chat. To change a particular timeline clip, reference that clip and describe your idea.
助手完成后，可以到脚本、画布或时间线看看效果。只收到文字建议时，可以接着说「把这: When the assistant finishes, look at the script, canvas or timeline. If you only received advice, follow up with “Save this plan to Script.” The operation details in chat show what changed.
助手的修改会出现在对应工作区，你可以直接编辑，也可以继续告诉它哪里需要调整。: The assistant’s changes appear in the relevant workspace. Edit them yourself or tell it what you would like to adjust.
读一遍，想象画面和声音: Read it through and picture the scene
改了脚本，再看看镜头: Revisit the shots after changing the script
改完脚本，可以回到关联镜头，看看原来的画面还合不合适。已有图片、视频和剪辑会保留: After editing the script, revisit the linked shots to see whether the visuals still fit. Existing images, videos and edits stay in place; adjust or regenerate the parts you want to change.
一份完整脚本，以及对应的镜头设计。你能看到每个镜头拍什么、怎么动，接着就可以制作: A complete script with its shot plan. Each shot describes what to show and how it moves, ready for you to produce the visuals.
可以先试做一个镜头，找到喜欢的画面和风格，再继续往下做。: Try one shot first. Find a look you like, then build from there.
等画面回来，先看一看: Preview the result when it arrives
喜欢这个结果，就选择「加入时间线」，到「成片」看看效果。还想调整的话，可以引用这: Like the result? Choose Add to timeline and see it in Film. To refine it, reference the result and tell the assistant what to keep or change. Keep other versions on the canvas for later.
看一遍，保存你的作品: Watch it through and save your video
从头看一遍，留意有没有多余的黑屏、声音是否合适、字幕是否跟得上。满意后点击「导出: Watch the whole video, checking for unwanted gaps, comfortable sound levels and well-timed captions. When you are happy, choose Export film → Start export. Preview the finished film, then use Save MP4… to put it where you want.
一支带有画面、声音和字幕的 MP4，可以用播放器打开，也可以分享给别人。: An MP4 with your visuals, sound and captions, ready to play or share.
第一版可以先用简单的直接切换。之后想丰富画面，再为支持的相邻底层片段添加转场，或: Straight cuts are a good place to start. Later, add transitions between eligible adjacent base-track clips or refine the color.
看看项目是否已保存: Check that your project has saved
给素材换个存放位置: Move your media to a new folder
遇到卡住的地方，可以先看看这里。点击问题展开解决方法。: If you get stuck, start here. Open a question to see what to try.
先到「通用设置 → 存储」看看素材目录是否可用。如果素材在移动硬盘上，重新连接就: Check that the media folder in General → Storage is available. Reconnect an external drive if you use one. If files were moved, put them back in their original locations and check whether they reappear.
如果还是没解决，可以把系统版本、操作步骤和错误提示一起反馈。发送前记得隐藏 AP: Still stuck? Include your system version, the steps you took and the error message when reporting the issue. Hide API keys and private information before sending.
把图片和视频剪成作品: Turn your images and videos into a film
和 AI 一起写脚本、准备画面: Write and create visuals with AI
试试「字幕」「导出」这样的词，或清除搜索看看目录。: Try a word like “captions” or “export”, or clear the search to browse the contents.
熟悉这些按键，剪辑时就能少点几次鼠标。: A few familiar keys can save you clicks while editing.
剪辑前先选中片段，在时间尺上点一下，把播放头放到想操作的位置。正在输入文字时，这: Select a clip and click the ruler to place the playhead where you want to edit. When you are typing, these keys keep their usual text-editing behavior.
